narr: A weak area of low pressure provided enough lift and instability to fuel scattered thunderstorms over Mohave County. A few storms produced flash flooding.
ev: A webcam showed the Vock Wash flooded Stockton Hill Rd.
Huffriter Rd was closed from Hwy 93 to Back Rd.
Bogels Ranch Rd was closed from Upper Trout Creek Rd to Back Rd.
Pump Station Rd was closed from Hwy 93 to Back Rd.
lsr: MOHAVE COUNTY FLOOD CONTROL WEBCAM SHOWS WATER FLOWING OVER STOCKTON HILL ROAD AT VOCK WASH.
BOGELS RANCH ROAD IS CLOSED FROM UPPER TROUT CREEK TO BACK ROAD DUE TO FLASH FLOODING.
HUFFRITTER ROAD IS CLOSED FROM BACK ROAD TO US HIGHWAY 93 DUE TO FLASH FLOODING.
PUMP STATION ROAD IS CLOSED FROM BACK ROAD TO US HIGHWAY 93 DUE TO FLASH FLOODING.
